locations.title: Heart Piece
locations.description:
**Location:** One of the first Pieces of Heart that you can claim will come soon after you meet Princess Zelda for the first time, and return to Hyrule Field. Head south to Lon Lon Ranch, where there's a large field full of horses. From the large field, head to the large crumbled tower in the far southwest corner of the ranch and head inside. There's a storage area here with nine milk crates, and a large metal grate at the end. Pull out the closest crates to empty two spots in the middle column, and then pull back the crate in the middle against the wall. This will reveal a small gap you can crawl through.  


On the other side you'll find your first Piece of Heart! For every four pieces you find, you'll earn a new Heart Container to add to your total health!

locations.title: Heart Piece
locations.description:
**Location:** Another early Heart Piece is found in Kakariko Village, off to the northeast of Hyrule. Once there, you can head up the stairs to the left and climb to the roof of a building near a large wooden tower, where you can spot a man on another rooftop nearby who has something for you, but getting to him can be tricky.

  


Grab a nearby Cucco that's wandering around the path up to Death Mountain, and run over to the Windmill. From here, you can jump over the fence to the other side, where a ladder leads up to a hilltop behind the large windmill. When you grab the Cucco on top of the hill behind the Windmill, make sure to leap over to the roof of Granny's Potion Shop (the blue rooftop). Carefully move to the other side of the blue roof closer to the wooden tower, and you'll find the man lounging on the lower roof section. He'll be so happy someone's come to see him that he'll give you a Piece of Heart!

locations.title: Heart Piece
locations.description:
**Location:** Beyond the village of Kakariko past the Windmill is the town's graveyard. By night, Dampe the Gravedigger will wander the grounds, and offer Dampe's Heart-Poundin' Grave-Diggin' Tour!  


Request to play Dante's Grave-digging tour, and he'll reveal several dirt mounds all across the graveyard area. You can guide him to any of the dirt mounds and interact with them to pay Dampe 10 Rupees to dig in the spot. Whatever comes up is yours to keep... provided something is actually buried there. Sometimes you'll get a few Rupees, other times nothing at all, but keep at it until he detects something heavy and asks for another 5 Rupees to keep at it, as it contains his special prize: A Piece of Heart!

locations.title: Heart Piece
locations.description:
**Location:** Pull back the grave at the far southern edge of this same row below the royal tomb, and you'll find one more tomb to drop into. No enemies here, but a large Treasure Chest holds a Piece of Heart -- which should be the fourth one you've found to grant you an extra Heart Container!



_This can also be done as adult Link!_

locations.title: Heart Piece
locations.description:
**Location:** When exploring Hyrule Castle Town, you'll run into a lady who's constantly doting on her little white dog named [Richard](#loc=1063868). However, once you've opened up the gate leading to Death Mountain, you can return to the Castle Town to find out from her that Richard has gone missing, and you'll be tasked to find him amid all the other stray dogs that descend upon Castle Town in the evening.



To find Richard, head down the alleyway past the Bomchu Shop near where the lady and her dog live. Richard should appear around the back corner, not far from the Treasure Chest Shop (there are a few other white dogs in other parts of the alley, so you may grab the wrong one and need a do-over).  

Interact with the dog to get it to follow you, then return to the lady. If it's the right dog, she'll be overjoyed and award you a Piece of Heart!

locations.title: Heart Piece
locations.description: **Location:** Once you reach Goron City, you'll be tasked to find a song to cheer up Darunia, which you can get by finding Saria in the Lost Wood's Sacred Grove. Once you have it, head back into the Lost Woods, and from the starting point, take a left. This leads to a small grove with a friendly Skull Kid playing on his flute. Step onto the smaller trunk, and play Saria's Song with him. Any friend of Saria's is a friend of his, and he'll reward this new bond with a new Piece of Heart for you!

locations.title: Heart Piece
locations.description:
**Location:** Once Saria has given you the Fairy Ocarina, you can enter the Lost Woods atop Kokiri Forest. From the entrance to the wooded maze, follow the music right to the east. This next area has a lower pathway where two more Skull Kids are playing their instruments on large tree trunks. Join with them using your Ocarina, and they'll start a game of "follow the tune". You'll need to repeat a randomized tune of notes that build from 3-5, and if you can follow along, they'll pass you a Blue Rupee. 

Try it again, and this time you'll have to follow the notes that build from 4-6. If you're having trouble as they hide which notes you need to memorize, look for the placement on the prompt to clue you in on which notes you need to remember. Complete this task, and you'll earn a Red Rupee worth 20. 

Play their game one last time for a super hard version of following notes that build from 6 to 8. If you can keep following along, you'll earn the ultimate prize: a new Piece of Heart!

locations.title: Heart Piece
locations.description:
**Location:** In Goron City, there's a large Goron-shaped pot in the middle of the city at its bottom level. After meeting Darunia, you can light the torches around the pot using a lit Deku Stick, and the pot will begin to spin. 

Once you have the Bomb Bag from Dodongo Cavern, return to the spinning pot, and look for a plank that puts you close to the top of the pot. You'll want to toss a bomb into the spinning pot, ideally when the "Happy" face is facing you. The pot will spin wildly, and depending on the face it stops spinning on, you can earn different prizes. If it lands on the "Happy" face, you'll get a Piece of Heart!

locations.title: Heart Piece
locations.description:
**Location:** Once you're able to reach the summit of Death Mountain after completing Dodongo Cavern, there's two Pieces of Heart hiding in the extreme heat of the Death Mountain Crater. Be warned, after around 4 seconds, you'll start to take a quarter heart damage every second, so you'll need to move quickly.

From the entrance, quickly dash down the slope and then to the right between two large rocks, and look for some mesh along the ground leading to a wall you can climb down the face of the inner volcano. Just below these two mesh spots is a Piece of Heart hiding in an alcove (which will also reset the time it takes to start taking damage), just be sure to quickly leap back up the mesh after claiming it!

locations.title: Heart Piece
locations.description:
**Location:** Once you're able to reach the summit of Death Mountain after completing Dodongo Cavern, there's two Pieces of Heart hiding in the extreme heat of the Death Mountain Crater. Be warned, after around 4 seconds, you'll start to take a quarter heart damage every second, so you'll need to move quickly.

Sprint down the slope from the entrance to the northwest to spot a low platform, near a broken bridge with a large grey rock in the way making it impossible to cross. What you can do from this side is find a Business Deku Scrub here -- of all places! He'll sell you another Piece of Heart for 100 Rupees. It's a steep price, but well worth it (and will reset the time until you start taking damage).

locations.title: Heart Piece
locations.description:
**Location:** Once you're able to reach the summit of Death Mountain after completing Dodongo Cavern, you can climb up the Death Mountain Trail to reach the top. Here, you'll find Kaepora Gaebora the Owl. He'll offer to give you a ride down to Kakariko Village, which you should accept and enjoy the flight!

Kaepora Gaebora will drop you off on top of Impa's House of all places, but don't jump off just yet. Carefully move to the back of the rooftop, and look down for a small cow pen that's been hidden behind sealed gates. On the roof of the pen is a Piece of Heart that can't be accessed except from this roof, so hop down onto the lower roof of the cow pen and claim your prize!

If exploring the area as an adult, you can use your Hookshot gained from the Graveyard on the bright green vines to the left of Impa's House to get over the fence.

_This can also be done as adult Link!_

locations.title: Heart Piece
locations.description:
**Location:** Once you've completed the Dodongo's Cavern dungeons and open up supply lines from the Gorons back to the townsfolk of Hyrule Castle Town, you'll have access to the Bombchu Bowling Alley near the center of town. For the cost of 10 Rupees, you can try your hand at navigating Bombchus into a target on a far wall, avoiding obstacles and banking them off walls to reach 3 goals with 10 Bombchus. It'll take a bit of practice and angling, but there are some wonderful prizes to earn as you unlock harder courses:

- Beginner Course: 10 Bombchus
- Advanced Course: Biggest Bomb Bag
- Expert Course: Piece of Heart

For the harder courses, we recommend looking for a way to angle the Bombchus off the wall at angles to reach the back, or look for the small gaps between obstacles to drive a straight path through threading anything in the way -- timing is crucial!

locations.title: Heart Piece
locations.description:
**Location:** Once you have access to a bomb bag, you can begin to explore Zora River, and partway up the river path you may notice a Piece of Heart sitting on a high ledge with no way to reach it. Climb up the path leading further east, and look back where the river splits down to the southwest. There's also a high ledge at the back of the large island in the middle of the river. You can't swim up to it... but you can float to it.

Return back to the sealed gate by the start of the river and grab the lone Cucco. With all the enemies nearby defeated, you can safely escort it, throwing it over the last ledge before you climb up, and then use it to float down to the high platform, and use the vines to climb up to the top of the island.

Looking north, you can spot a high platform over the singing frogs that hold a Piece of Heart, but no way to reach it. Instead, head to the southern part of the island and across to a high ledge that hides a second Grotto entrance. In here, you'll find another Cucco. Grab the Cucco and take him with you as you exit the Grotto, and then cross to the narrow platform where a Sheikah Stone is. From here, leap down to the Heart Piece using the second Cucco to float across!

_This can also be done as adult Link!_

locations.title: Heart Piece
locations.description:
**Location:** Once you have access to a bomb bag, you can begin to explore Zora River, and you'll find a Cucco wandering around on the other side of a sealed gate past a Bean Seller. Be sure to take the Cucco with you as you continue up the Zora River trail to where the entrance to Zora's Domain is. There are several crossing platforms here. On the other side, a high ledge overlooks a second Piece of Heart on a tiny platform to the northwest. Use that Cucco you held earlier to do one more floating jump across the falls to reach it.

_This can also be done as adult Link!_

locations.title: Heart Piece
locations.description:
**Location:** Upon reaching Zora's Domain, there's a secret Piece of Heart you can reveal by solving a little puzzle. Head up to the Audience Chamber in front of King Zora, and look around, noting the two lit torches at the entrance to the audience chamber. You can use a Deku Stick and run down the steps to light torches along the way.

Keep running between torches and then stowing your stick before taking it out again as you head down to the bottom level, and follow a path behind the large waterfall to find two final braziers to light, which will reveal a Treasure Chest in the middle holding a Piece of Heart.

_This can also be done as adult Link!_

locations.title: Heart Piece
locations.description:
**Location:** When in Lake Hylia, you can visit a small area across the water from the two scarecrows to find Lake Hylia's own Fishing Pond. It's here you can rent out a fishing rod and try your luck and land a big haul! The set-up is pretty straightforward: try to find a big-looking fish in the middle of the pod, cast your line near it, then gently pull back with ZR and wiggle your line to get its attention.

When it does, you'll need to alternate holding left or right -- whichever direction the fish is trying to flee in, until it gets tired and stops for a moment. When it does, hold down ZR and keep reeling in until it resumes its frantic escape. Keep it up, and the fish will be yours.

The owner is pretty good at judging the size at a distance, and if you bring him anything over 40cm, and you'll be awarded a Piece of Heart!

locations.title: Heart Piece
locations.description:
**Location:** Though much of Gerudo Valley is inaccessible to Child Link, there are still two Pieces of Heart you can locate fairly early (or come back as an adult). Though the bridge gate is closed, there are sections of the valley wall you can jump to, and along the opposite side you can spy a large Treasure Chest. The gap is normally too big to cross, but there happens to be a Cucco nearby that you can grab and float across the valley to the other side. Open the Treasure Chest, and you'll find a Piece of Heart inside!

_This can also be done as adult Link!_

locations.title: Heart Piece
locations.description:
**Location:** Though much of Gerudo Valley is inaccessible to Child Link, there are still two Pieces of Heart you can locate fairly early (or come back as an adult). Look for a Cucco wandering near the bridge, and use it to carefully float down to the large alcove at the bottom of the valley with the raging river below that feeds out to Lake Hylia. Jump off with the Cucco and slowly float down to a large alcove along the waterline.

Head up this large alcove path up north toward the giant waterfall. You'll find there's actually a path behind the waterfall, and you can climb it to reach another Piece of Heart!

locations.title: Heart Piece
locations.description:
**Location:** If you travel toward the entrance to Gerudo Valley, look under a large rock outcropping and you'll find a small Treasure Chest. However, as a child, there seems to be no way to unlock it.

To find a way to unlock it, you'll need to become Adult Link. Return to inspect the Treasure Chest in the future to find fairy writing nearby, urging you specifically to take what's inside before someone else does. Unfortunately, someone else already has. After completing the Forest Temple, you can then return to being Child Link, and head back to find the Treasure Chest can now be opened to nab a Piece of Heart!

locations.title: Heart Piece
locations.description:
**Location:** If you look just to the east of Hyrule Castle Town's gate along the moat, you can find a cracked stone that you can bomb revealing a Grotto entrance. Inside is a peculiar Deku Business Scrub, who won't trade with you unless you know the password. 

To get the password, you'll have to become Adult Link, and return to the Grotto entrance. Nearby on a tree, you can now find fairy writing which has the password. Unfortunately, as an adult, the Scrub has already sold his wares. Once you complete the Forest Temple, return to being Child Link, and use the password on the Scrub to buy his Piece of Heart for 100 Rupees!

locations.title: Heart Piece
locations.description:
**Required:** Song of Storms

**Location:** After using the Ocarina to learn the Song of Storms from the Windmill Man as Adult Link in Kakariko Village, return to the past. As Young Link, head to Zora River to speak with the frogs, and play the Song of Storms. They'll be delighted for the rainfall, and award you a Piece of Heart.

locations.title: Heart Piece
locations.description:
**Required:** Learned all six non-teleport songs (Zelda's Lullaby, Epona's Song, Saria's Song, Sun's Song, Song of Time and the Song of Storms)

**Location:** After you've played all six non-teleport songs for the group of frogs along Zora River, speak with the group again to play a minigame with them. They'll ask you to play the right tune matching the fly hovering over each frog. Play the sequence quickly, and you can earn a Piece of Heart.

**Solution:** L, Y, A, R, Y, A, R, L, R, L, R, A, Y, L

locations.title: Heart Piece
locations.description:
Turn in 50 tokens at the Cursed Spider House

**Location:** To get this Piece of Heart, you'll need to have done your job hunting down Gold Skulltulas across Hyrule. You can follow our guide to claim the tokens as you progress through the game, which should get you to the 50 mark around the time you complete the Forest Temple. Once you have at least 50 Gold Skulltula Tokens, return to the Cursed Spider House in Kakariko Village, and talk to the father to get your reward.

_This can also be done as adult Link!_

locations.title: Heart Piece
locations.description:
**Required:** Lenses of Truth

**Location:** After learning the Song of Storms from the Windmill Man as an adult, and playing it for him as a child, you'll be able to access the mini-dungeon at the Bottom of the Well, where you can uncover the Lenses of Truth item to see the contents of chests before you open them. Use this by returning to Castle Town and playing the Treasure Chest game, using the Lenses to locate all the keys to the next room to claim your prize—a Piece of Heart.

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description: **Location:** This Gold Skulltula is located on the top Floor 3F of the dungeon, found in the room with the Compass. You'll need to step on the small stone switch to raise up three platforms in the middle of the room, but instead of cross, stick to the left side of the middle platform. Defeat the Skulltula blocking a high ledge, then jump up to find the Gold Skulltula against the wall at your height.

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description: **Location:** This one can be found as soon as you reach the top of the dungeon and jump down to create a hole to the basement by destroying the webbing in the center of the room. As you swim out of the pool of water, be sure to turn around. There's a large vine wall leading back up to the first floor in case you need to get back, but more importantly is a Gold Skulltula. You can defeat it with your slingshot, and then climb up to retrieve the token.

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** This one can be found as soon as you reach the top of the dungeon and jump down to create a hole to the basement by destroying the webbing in the center of the room, and is located in the same area as the previous Gold Skulltula.

As you drop down near the large dividing pool of water, check the northern side to find a large grate where a third Gold Skulltula is hiding. You can shoot it from afar with your Slingshot, and then leap to the grate to claim the token.

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** To reach it, you'll need to make your way through the passageways in the northwest, located west of the webbed hole leading down to the boss arena on B2.

The room the Gold Skultulla is hiding in is the one where three Gohma Larva will fall down from the ceiling. Once defeated, note the webbing in the top northwest corner of the room. Use the nearby lit torch to light up a Deku Stick so you can burn the webbing away, and defeat the Deku Baba and regular Skulltula guarding the path to the final Gold Skultulla of this dungeon. It's sitting high on some vines at the back of the room, and you can slingshot it before climbing up to get the token.

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** As soon as you enter Hyrule Field for the first time, there are already two Gold Skulltulas that you can track down, if you know where to look. One is hidden in a tree on the eastern side of Hyrule Field, not far from the entrance to the Kokiri Forest. Cross the small stream to reach it, and then roll into the tree, and a Gold Skulltula will fall out.

_This can also be done as adult Link!_

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description: **Location:** While the Hyrule Castle Town is a fairly busy area, you can actually find a Gold Skulltula hiding in the town as soon as you enter from Hyrule Field. Start by taking an immediate right into a room by the castle town gate, and you'll find an armory room littered with pots and crates, and one very bored guardsman. Roll into the large crates by the guard at the far end of the room to find one is hiding a Gold Skultulla, which you can kill and claim its token.

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description: **Location:** To reach it, you'll need to make your way past the initial group of guards by the front gate, which means climbing up and over the gatehouse, and jumping down into the gardens. From here, dart between the hedges by taking the middle path, and then hang around the outside to climb up the western wall to bypass the large locked gate. Look for a small enclosed area to the right of the vine wall leading up to the moat for some barrels and sacks, and a lone tall and narrow tree. Roll into it, and you'll dislodge a Gold Skulltula from its hiding place!

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** As you enter the ranch, be sure to check around the northeast side of the ranch, behind the main house Talon is in. There's a small yard area with a wooden tower, and two trees. Roll into the tall and narrow tree, and you can dislodge a Gold Skulltula here!

_This can also be done as adult Link!_

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description: **Location:** One Gold Skulltula is hiding atop the main tall tree at the entrance to the village, where the Master Craftsman yells at his workers all day (and where his son slinks out to and rests at night). Roll into the tree to dislodge the spider and claim its token.

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description: **Location:** One can be found by simply walking outside the Cursed Spider House and waiting for nightfall. A small golden spiderweb just to the left of the door is its hiding spot, where the Gold Skulltula will appear only at night!

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description: **Location:** Once night has fallen in Kakariko Village, inspect the building under construction on the south side of the village, near the Cucco Lady, and you'll find a Gold Skulltula on a high ledge of the red brick wall, and you can use the scaffolding to reach it.

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** Another Gold Skulltula similarly only appears at night in Kakariko Village, and can be found along the ladder of the tall wooden tower in the center of town, along the pathway up to the Gate to Death Mountain. Hit it with your slingshot and then climb up to retrieve the token.

**Requires:** Slingshot

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description: **Location:** Another Gold Skulltula in Kakariko Village is hiding out of view, and likewise only appears at night. To the south of the wooden tower and Potion Shop is another building where a little boy lives (usually out playing in the graveyard), and if you circle around the back of the house, you can find a Gold Skulltula in its web along the building wall.

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** There are two Gold Skulltulas in the Graveyard beyond Kakariko Village, but one can be reached earlier than the other as a child. You can head up the steps on the left side to find a plot of soft soil on the other side of a small tree. Drop a Bug from your bottle (if you don't have one, look under the stones at the Graveyard entrance), and it will fish out a Gold Skulltula for you to defeat!

**Requires:** Bug (Bottled)

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** Once you've obtained an Empty Bottle and place a bug in it, return to Kokiri Forest. Look around the back of the Kokiri Shop, and you should be able to spot a patch of soft soil. Plant a bug in it, and a Gold Skulltula will jump out for you to slay.

**Requires:** Bug (Bottled)

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description: **Location:** While you can't find this Gold Skultula when your adventure first starts, you can return here after meeting Princess Zelda and the time of day begins to change from day to night. Use the Sun's Song (or sleep in Link's bed) to make sure it's nightfall in the forest, and then check around the back of the Home of the Know-It-All Brothers by the Training Grounds. It's here you'll find a new Skulltulla hiding along the treehouse wall.

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** Upon entering the Lost Woods with a Bug in a bottle, take a left as soon as you enter. From this grove with the solitary Skull Kid, be sure to move south through a nearby tunnel. It will take you to a high ledge overlooking the bridge leading out of Kokiri Forest, and you can find some soft soil here. Drop a bug in, and out will pop another Gold Skulltulla to defeat.

**Requires:** Bug (Bottled)

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** Upon entering the Lost Woods with a Bug in a bottle, take the path to where the shortcut to Goron City is. Head right to the pool of water, then left going north, and take another left. This will lead you to a smaller meadow teeming with several Business Scrubs. On the side near a large tree is some soft soil, which you can again drop a Bug into (one of the scrubs actually sells Bugs!) to reveal the last Gold Skulltula that you can get for now in this area.

**Requires:** Bug (Bottled)

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** Once you have obtained the Goron Bracelet from Daruina in Goron City, you'll be able to pick up and throw Bomb Flowers. Exit Goron City back onto the Death Mountain Trail. Head over to the Goron babysitting the lone Bomb Flower, and try grabbing it. You can then toss it over the ledge and down toward the large cracked boulder blocking the entrance to Dodongo Cavern, which will explode to reveal its entrance!

Note the patch of soft soil just inside the tunnel, and drop a Bug inside to scare out a Gold Skulltula that you can defeat for a token.

**Requires:** Goron Bracelet, Bug (Bottled)

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Dodongo Cavern dungeon, this one can be found in the first hallway leading east from the main entrance hall with the giant skull. Near the back of the hall where three Baby Dodongos emerge is a large cracked wall. While there are no Bomb Flowers around, you can either lure the exploding enemies near the wall, or come back with bombs when you have them. Behind the cracked wall is a Gold Skulltula flanked by a few Keese waiting to ambush you.

**Requires:** Goron Bracelet or Bombs

_This can also be done as adult Link!_

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Dodongo Cavern dungeon, this one can be found on the northwestern side of the first floor, off the main entrance room with the large skull, Make your way north to an area with a large raised staircase high above you. There are Bomb Flowers all around its base, with a small gap near the front. Look for a separate Bomb Flower away from the rest, and place it in the small gap so you can unleash one continuous explosion setting off all the bombs in a chain around the stairs.

This will erode the structure, causing it to sink into the ground, and make the large staircase accessible to climb up. Head up from the large stairs to the higher level on the south side of the room, but be sure to turn around before you reach the exit. There's a large mesh wall here, with a Gold Skulltula hanging from the side among some Skullwalltulas. Hit them with slingshots, then climb up the mesh to grab your token.

**Requires:** Goron Bracelet, Slingshot

_This can also be done as adult Link!_

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Dodongo Cavern dungeon, you can find this one on the second floor of the large entrance hall, just after acquiring a Bomb Bag and some Bombs. At the far northeast corner of this area by the giant skull, there's another cracked wall you can detonate with a bomb. This will reveal a room with two Dodongos pacing around a large rock in the middle of the room, and on the other side you'll find a Gold Skulltula hiding (which can be killed by a detonating Dodongo!).

**Requires:** Bombs

_This can also be done as adult Link!_

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Dodongo Cavern dungeon, you'll find this spider after you have unlocked the secret passage through the giant skull by dropping bombs in the eye sockets.

Head through to a room with several narrow pathways and stone blocks to push around and drop. After pushing the block down to the lower level, be sure and push the fallen block all the way to the far wall, where there's a ledge with a large cracked wall. Toss a bomb on top of the stone block to blast apart the wall, then climb up to find a small room. There are several Baby Dodongos waiting to ambush you, and near the back you'll find a Gold Skulltula hiding behind an Armos statue, which you can also toss a bomb at to detonate them both (or lure the Baby Dodongos into)!

**Requires:** Bombs

_This can also be done as adult Link!_

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** After you have acquired the Bomb Bag from Dodongo Cavern, return to the start of the Death Mountain Trail. Just after rounding the corner from the path to Kakariko Village, look for a cracked stone wall by the Red Tektites. You can blow up the wall, and even if it's not nightfall, a Gold Skulltula can be found on the other side for you to defeat.

**Requires:** Bombs

_This can also be done as adult Link!_

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Required:** Bombs

**Location:** After getting the Bomb Bag, return to Goron City. On the entrance tier, head along to the upper left side and blast through the boulders to find a room full of brown and gray rocks, as well as strange black obelisks.

You can bomb a path through the cracked boulders heading right, then left, then straight to find two Treasure Chests with a Blue Rupee apiece, and a crate hiding a Gold Skulltula!

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** Once you're able to reach the summit of Death Mountain after completing Dodongo Cavern, there's a Gold Skulltula hiding in the extreme heat of the Death Mountain Crater. Be warned, after around 4 seconds, you'll start to take a quarter heart damage every second, so you'll need to move quickly.

Since you'll want to move quickly here, focus on running forward and look for two wooden crates by a pot on the left side. Roll into the furthest crate to find a Gold Skulltula hiding inside.

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** On the southern side of Hyrule Field, look for a large wooded area south of Lon Lon Ranch. Over by a large Peahat, there's a crack on the ground you can use a bomb on to reveal a Grotto. Inside the Grotto, you can find another Gold Skulltula to defeat. You won't be able to get up to your prize without the Boomerang, however.

**Requires:** Bombs, Boomerang

_This can also be done as adult Link!_

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Required:** Bombs, Bug (Bottled)

**Location:** Once you have a Bomb Bag from completing Dodongo's Cavern, you'll be able to head into the Zora River region south of Kakariko Village. You can then blow up the boulders blocking access along the river. This leads to a man selling Magic Beans, which can be planted in the soft soil you can also find Gold Skulltulas in. One such patch of soft soil is right next to the Bean Seller, and so you can lure out a Gold Skulltula here by dropping a Bug into the soil.

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Required:** Bombs

**Location:** Once you have a Bomb Bag from completing Dodongo's Cavern, you'll be able to head into the Zora River region south of Kakariko Village. Head all the way up the river path to the hidden entrance to Zora's Domain behind a large waterfall. While inspecting the area around the falls, you can jump down at the base of the falls, and there's vines near a central platform to take you back up. Be sure to stick around this area at night, as a Gold Skulltula will appear around the backside of where the vines are for you to defeat.

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Lake Hylia region to the south of Hyrule Field, you can find this one by the large observatory building. Outside, you can find a patch of soft soil, so be sure to send a Bug from a bottle in to scare up a Gold Skulltula.

**Requires:** Bug (Bottled)

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** One of several Gold Skulltulas that can be found in the Lake Hylia region to the south of Hyrule Field, this spider is in a location exclusive to the remake of Ocarina of Time, located at the far edge of the lake. From the large island with the huge tree and pedestal, start swimming for the far shores to the southwest.

Along the southern tip, look for the smallest of ledges you can climb up to find a tunnel entrance. You can shuffle through to the other side, where you'll find a Gold Skulltula.

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** After you've found the Empty Bottle in Lake Hylia with a note from Princess Ruto, you can show it to King Zora to be granted access to where Lord Jabu Jabu is at the Zora Fountain.

Off to the south, you can find a shallow path leading to a section of land with a few trees and a large cracked wall. Be sure to try rolling into the narrow tall trees here, and you can dislodge a Gold Skulltula!

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description: **Location:** One of the several Gold Skulltulas you can find within Jabu-Jabu's Belly, the dungeon atop Zora Fountain, you'll find this area soon after following Princess Ruto down to level B1, and taking the passage north. Located in this room, find a sunken area in the middle, you can step on the glowing switch in the middle to raise the water level here. Check out the vines leading up to a high ledge on the western side, where you'll find a few pots stashed away next to a Gold Skulltula!

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** One of the several Gold Skulltulas you can find within Jabu-Jabu's Belly, you'll need the Boomerang in order to obtain the spider's token. After you've defeated all the parasite tendrils blocking access to the two-tier room full of pits, jump down the blue-colored pit to a high ledge. From this ledge, first look to the north where some Biri float around to spot a Gold Skulltula along the wall. Using your Boomerang, you can now both hit it from a distance, and recover the Skull Token using your Boomerang!

**Requires:** Boomerang

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** One of the several Gold Skulltulas you can find within Jabu-Jabu's Belly, you'll need the Boomerang in order to obtain the spider's token. After you've defeated all the parasite tendrils blocking access to the two-tier room full of pits, jump down the blue-colored pit to a high ledge. Head down the hall toward the room to the northwest. This small corridor also has another Gold Skulltula hiding along the ceiling, which you can dislodge with your Boomerang and claim its token.

**Requires:** Boomerang

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** One of the several Gold Skulltulas you can find within Jabu-Jabu's Belly, you can find this spider in the final large room leading to the Boss arena. In this room with a sealed door and a very tall pillar with vines on the back side, look around to the backside of the tall pillar, and along the vines leading up to the top, you can find the last Gold Skulltula to claim in this dungeon with a shot from your Boomerang or Slingshot!

**Requires:** Boomerang

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** There's a Gold Skulltula hiding in the Zora Fountain, but it can only be obtained once you have access to the Boomerang from completing Lord Jabu-Jabu's Belly. Upon returning to the fountain, be sure to play the Sun's Song here. Look for a nearby archway in the water you can climb up, and on the far wall, a Gold Skulltula will appear at night, and you can toss your Boomerang to collect its token.

**Requires:** Boomerang

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** One of two Gold Skulltulas that you may have seen early in Lon Lon Ranch, these spiders can only be claimed once you have completed Lord Jabu-Jabu's Belly atop Zora Fountain. Now armed with your Boomerang, check out the main house just by the racetrack entrance at night, and you can find a Gold Skulltula hiding on a window that you can defeat and grab its token with your Boomerang.

**Requires:** Boomerang

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** One of two Gold Skulltulas that you may have seen early in Lon Lon Ranch, these spiders can only be claimed once you have completed Lord Jabu-Jabu's Belly atop Zora Fountain. Enter the crumbling tower in the southwest corner of the ranch at night, the one that was hiding a Piece of Heart. Look up for a high ledge with vines you can't quite reach, but your Boomerang can reach the Gold Skulltula skittering around above and nab its token.

**Requires:** Boomerang

_This can also be done as adult Link!_

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** Once you've obtained the Boomerang from Lord Jabu-Jabu's Belly (or retrieved the Hookshot as an adult in the Kakariko Village's Graveyard, head back into the Graveyard at night. Look behind Dampe's cabin, and you'll find another Gold Skulltula waiting for you on a high wall. Now with your Boomerang, you'll be able to defeat it and claim its token.

**Requires:** Boomerang

_This can also be done as adult Link!_

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** Though most of the region of Gerudo Valley is inaccessible to Child Link, there are a few Gold Skulltulas you can locate. Upon entering the Valley entrance, you'll approach a small wooden plank over a pool of water. Be sure to play the Sun's Song to turn day to night. Soon, a Golden Skulltula will emerge under the bridge, and you can hop down to defeat it and claim its token.

**Requires:** Boomerang

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** Though most of the region of Gerudo Valley is inaccessible to Child Link, there are a few Gold Skulltulas you can locate. Look around the bridge for a wandering Cucco, grab it and look down at the bottom of the valley with the raging river below that feeds out to Lake Hylia. Jump off with the Cucco and slowly float down to a large alcove along the waterline.

It's here you'll find a lone Gerudo tending to her cow, and nearby is a patch of soft soil you can drop a Bug in to make another Gold Skulltula pop out.

**Requires:** Boomerang

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** While there are several Gold Skulltulas you can find in Lake Hylia, one will require the Boomerang found in Lord Jabu-Jabu's Belly. Head up to the Observatory and start walking across the rope bridge. Play the Sun's Song to turn day to night, and look back to spot a Gold Skulltula just out of reach, that you can now retrieve the token from with your Boomerang.

**Requires:** Boomerang

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** After you visit the Windmill as Adult Link and learn the Song of Storms from the crazed Windmill Man, you can use it to reveal certain grottos. Return to Child Link after completing the Forest Temple, and head back to Hyrule Castle. Evade the guards until you return to the spot where Malon was sleeping, and in the southeast corner by the tree you can find a strange plant with propeller-looking leaves. Play the Song of Storms to make the leaves spin and reveal a Grotto. Down below, bomb the cracked walls to locate a Gold Skulltula.

**Requires:** Song of Storms

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Required:** Bug (Bottled)

**Location:** This Gold Skulltula resides in the burning heart of Death Mountain, but to reach it, you'll need to have gained access to the Fire Temple as Adult Link. Once you do, make sure you have a bottled Bug, and return back to being Child Link and play the Bolero of Fire to warp outside the temple. Quickly plant the bugs into the nearby soft soil to reveal a Gold Skulltula.

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Required:** Song of Storms, Lenses of Truth

**Location:** After learning the Song of Storms from the Windmill Man as an adult and playing it for him as a child, you can enter the mini-dungeon at the Bottom of the Well. We recommend completing it to find the Lenses of Truth first to avoid any pitfalls. In the main area with a long square pathway wrapping around a central room, head to the top northeast corner and use the Lenses to avoid a pitfall to enter a door here. Cross the invisible pits to the other side to find a room with a Like Like, and it guards a Gold Skulltula on the wall behind it.

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Required:** Song of Storms, Lenses of Truth

**Location:** In the Bottom of the Well mini-dungeon, there are two Gold Skulltulas each behind two locked doors. To find the first one, get the Lenses of Truth and return to the main area with the long walkways around a central square room, Head to the southeast corner and then turn toward the square room in the middle to find an opening with the Lenses that holds a Small Key. enter the large central room and make your way to the northeast corner to unlock the door to the Gold Skulltula past a pit with an invisible walkway.

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Required:** Song of Storms, Lenses of Truth

**Location:** In the Bottom of the Well mini-dungeon, there are two Gold Skulltulas each behind two locked doors. To find the second one, once you have lowered the water level, look along the west side of the main chamber for a hallway with a pit of water you can dive under to the other side, and burn the coffins in the next room to locate a Small Key. Return to the central room with the key and unlock the door in the northwest corner, where you'll find a Gold Skulltula guarded by a Deku Baba.

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** After you've crossed the Mirage Desert past Gerudo Fortress, you'll arrive at the Evil Desert Colossus where the Spirit Temple is. Once you try to enter as Adult Link, you'll find that only Child Link can fit in a tunnel, prompting Sheik to teach you the melody to warp here. Return as Child Link and bring a bottled Bug with you. There's a patch of soft soil just by the entrance you can place the bug in to reveal the Gold Skulltula. (Be sure to also plant some Magic Beans so that you can get another Gold Skulltula later!)

**Requires:** Bug (Bottled)

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** Entering the Spirit Temple as Child Link, you can find a few Gold Skulltulas at this point in time. One can be found early on, after crawling through the tunnel to the northwest, and taking the door to the right. When you enter a room with a large mesh wall containing several Keese, there will also be a Gold Skulltula on the wall as well.

**Requires:** Boomerang

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** Entering the Spirit Temple as Child Link, you can find a few Gold Skulltulas at this point in time. One can be found early on, after you ascend to the floor 2F, and take the path east into a large room with a giant statue. Check the bottom right corner of the room by the statue's folded legs to find a Gold Skulltula hiding away.

**Requires:** Boomerang

locations.title: Gold Skulltula
locations.description:
**Location:** Entering the Spirit Temple as Child Link, you can find a few Gold Skulltulas at this point in time. One can be found after ascending to the floor 3F in the room with the large statue, and taking the pathway to the southwest. This leads to a sunlight puzzle room with several Beamos. Head down into the corridor to the south leading to the colossus arms, and then turn around upon entering and look up to spot a Gold Skulltula here.

**Requires:** Boomerang

locations.title: Kokiri Sword
locations.description: Inside a chest on the pedestal

locations.title: Fairy Slingshot
locations.description: Inside chest

locations.title: Deku Shield
locations.description: Purchase for 40 Rupees

locations.title: Hylian Shield
locations.description: Purchase for 40 Rupees

locations.title: Hylian Shield
locations.description:
**Location:** Head up to the row of graves just before the steps up to the Royal Tomb. Pull back the second one on the right side of the pathway to reveal another tomb entrance. Inside is a Redead, but thankfully you have the Sun's power to stun it in it's tracks.

The Hylian Shield is inside a treasure chest.
